title: Ultra Roasted Venezuelan Chicken Skewers
description: A solo dinner dish featuring roasted chicken skewers with a blend of Venezuelan spices and curry powder, served on a wooden board.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together curry powder, olive oil, lime juice, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a wooden board lined with parchment paper.
Roast the chicken skewers in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the chicken skewers hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
